state_contract_review: Trusted expected payload digest is mandatory; result identity fields canonically bind to the authenticated payload.
Preflight cannot claim completed or pending work. Any later phase or model call requires complete loaded provenance and the selected adapter identity.
Pending first training call requires initialization, inventory and the fresh zero-state optimizer; pending batch boundaries require the preceding optimizer update.
Snapshot168 is required before pending training index672 or completed count673. Failure exactly at the snapshot boundary may retain the incomplete save state.
Evaluation/reload work requires full successful training; reload/finalize require complete evaluation outputs. Untouched reload evidence remains valid during partial evaluation.
Terminal output/loss gaps are allowed only as failure evidence with no pending or subsequent work; counts remain observed completed counts and exclude pending calls.
Passed trained results bind the reload digest to the final changed training digest, all32 exact counterpart identities/winners and measured maximum logit delta <=0.001.
Structured adverse failures survive validation; rejected raw input is not repaired or mutated. Unknown host progress cannot be represented by null worker counts or a fabricated zero trace.
limitations: The historical finite-number helper raises OverflowError for candidate logits such as 10**400. It fails closed rather than accepting or coercing them. Future host invalid-result handling must preserve the raw result and exception for any ordinary validation exception, including OverflowError, not only ValueError. No historical helper was edited.

A consistent receipt does not prove physical model execution, authentic measurements, source Git/CI authority or saved tensor contents. The host must independently authenticate the payload/source and verify runtime, storage and teardown boundaries.
Host timeout/transport failure remains a separate unknown-progress envelope. These modules validate returned worker evidence and do not implement the future host or remote runtime.
